name: rodbot-lp-apk
description: Enveloppe Android (Capacitor) de la formation RodBot LP

scripts.sync: npm run build:web && npx cap sync android
scripts.apk: npm run sync && npx cap build android --androidreleasetype APK --signing-type apksigner --keystorepath "$PWD/android/keystore/rodbot-dev.keystore" --keystorepass rodbot-lp-dev --keystorealias rodbot --keystorealiaspass rodbot-lp-dev
